# FindurAI

> FindurAI is an AI tools discovery platform. Describe a task in natural language
> and find the best AI tools for it, with reviews, pricing, features, pros, cons,
> alternatives and FAQs.

## Key pages
- Home: https://findurai.com/
- Search: https://findurai.com/search
- Compare: https://findurai.com/compare
- Blog: https://findurai.com/blog
- About: https://findurai.com/about
